ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) speckling and markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across both lobes; localized high-contrast white speckling concentrated along the lower fluke margins and mid-surfaces; two distinct circular ring-shaped features in the mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central notch with a sharp interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular profile with high-amplitude serrations; significant concave indentation on the left lobe trailing edge near the tip; multiple smaller jagged notches and peaks across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the notch to the tips, significantly disrupted by macro-level serrations and acquired trailing edge tissue loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent high-contrast circular scars located on the left lobe; high-frequency white spot clusters near both lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear white streaks oriented diagonally across the surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss (notches) along the trailing edge, notably a large indentation on the left lobe; presence of circular depigmented scars on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Evidence of biological colonization or residual attachment points (likely barnacles) visible as high-contrast clusters at the distal tips of both lobes.
